verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state fine-tuning jobs can be launched 'from the console, through the API/SDK, or with the CLI' (together-ai-docs-17), and dedicated endpoints, batch, serverless inference, and structured/function calling are all documented as API-accessible features mirroring console capabilities (together-ai-docs-4, -25, -3, -8). However, there's no evidence covering full parity for account/billing/team-management UI functions, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (together-ai-probe-3 shows 404s), leaving some doubt about complete API coverage. Missing for 10: explicit API parity for account/billing/org-admin UI features, a discoverable OpenAPI/spec reference, and independent confirmation of full parity beyond core inference/training workflows.
